block.archify.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.archify.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.archify.model.title: Archify
block.archify.model.description: Render typed Archify JSON as a standalone interactive HTML diagram using a pinned local engine.
block.archify.help_engine_directory: The archify/ directory of official Archify 3.0.1. Files are hash-checked; no download or install at Run.
block.archify.help_diagram_type: Auto follows diagram_type in the input. A selected type must match it.
block.archify.help_visual_preset: Keep the authored style or apply one of the official viewer presets.
block.archify.help_output_directory: Empty stores diagrams in this block’s instance storage. Otherwise choose an existing directory; files always get unique names.
block.archify.help_timeout_sec: Total render deadline, including the verified engine snapshot.
block.archify.help_max_input_bytes: Reject oversized JSON before launching Node.
block.archify.help_max_output_bytes: Maximum standalone HTML size. The embedded viewer is about 1 MB.
block.archify.help_max_artifacts: Maximum saved diagrams in the selected destination. No automatic deletion; inspect and archive files explicitly when full.
